name: Vapin Ape | Battery | Standard Edition
description:
Vapin Ape Battery for 1g and 0.5g Pods - PODS NOT INCLUDED

The last vape you'll ever need. Vapin Ape Smart Pods feature a long-lasting rechargeable battery and auto-recognition technology that detects your oil type and optimizes heat and airflow accordingly. Enjoy perfect hits for Distillate + HTE, Live Resin, or Hash Rosin. Advanced ceramic heating delivers smooth flavor and consistent performance with far less battery waste.

Compatible with Distillate, Live Resin Sauce, and Live Hash Rosin Pods
